latestAnnouncement.title: Halfway there. Where are you? 🛠️
latestAnnouncement.summary: The announcement reiterates the deadline and warns that a draft is not a submission. It asks entrants to verify the live WebMCP route, public repository and detectable licence, public YouTube video with audio, accepted team invitations and clear evidence for pre-existing work.

limitations: This is a time-bounded read-only observation of editable Devpost state, not a frozen submission receipt.
The project remains an unsubmitted blank draft; repository readiness does not populate or submit the Devpost form.
Only an authorised final submission and its returned receipt can establish that the project was submitted.
Entrant eligibility, residence, ownership, publicity, prize, tax and other legal attestations remain human decisions.
